description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeWorkExperienceAPI class, which implements CRUD operations for managing employee work experience records within a Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting work experience data, along with validation rules and API documentation annotations.
